description: Reference code: JR128460 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Comment allez-vous faire la différence ? En tant que RFO Trainee, vous aurez les responsabilités variées suivantes : Retail accounting : vous viendrez en support sur divers tâches comptables relatives aux flux en boutiques (paiements, remboursements, caisses …) et serez pleinement impliqué/e dans les phases de clôture mensuelle. Retail & Stock controlling : vous intégrerez l’environnement passionnant des opérations pour accompagner notre équipe dans le support opérationnel de nos boutiques du marché suisse (suivi et support des transactions, inventaires …) Internal control : garant de la bonne application des procédures et guidelines du Groupe, le contrôle interne est un rôle clé du bon fonctionnement de l’entité. Vous accompagnerez la responsable du contrôle interne dans son quotidien (suivi mensuel des contrôles, testing annuel). Quelles sont les clés de votre réussite au sein de notre Groupe ? Vous êtes à la recherche d'un poste de formation pour un CFC Employé de Commerce branche Administration & Service ou équivalent Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques Vous êtes motivé/e, rigoureux/se et aimez travailler en équipe Vous avez une sensibilité pour l’univers du Retail et pour l’opérationnel Vous parlez couramment français et avez des bases en anglais, l'allemand ou l’italien est un plus #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Responsable Contrôle Interne, Audit & Stocks (H/F) - CDD 12 mois Save Paris, France Richemont Polisseur confirmé H/F Save Paris, France Richemont GL Accountant Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR128460 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Come farai a fare la differenza? Come Allenatore RFO, avrete le seguenti responsabilità: Contabilità al dettaglio: si verrà a sostenere vari compiti contabili relativi al flusso di negozi (pagamenti, rimborsi, caisses ...) e saranno pienamente coinvolti nelle fasi di chiusura mensile. Retail & Stock Control: integrerai l'emozionante ambiente delle operazioni per supportare il nostro team nel supporto operativo dei nostri negozi di mercato svizzeri (monitoraggio e supporto delle transazioni, inventori...) Controllo interno: garantire la corretta applicazione delle procedure e delle linee guida del Gruppo, il controllo interno è un ruolo chiave per il corretto funzionamento dell'ente. Potrai accompagnare il capo del controllo interno nella sua vita quotidiana (controllo mensile dei controlli, test annuali). Quali sono le chiavi del vostro successo nel nostro Gruppo? Stai cercando una posizione di formazione per un ramo di SWC Trade Dipendenti Amministrazione e Servizio o equivalente Sei comodo con strumenti per computer Sei motivato, rigoroso e come lavorare come team Hai una sensibilità al mondo del Retail e operativo Parla fluentemente francese e ha basi in inglese, tedesco o italiano è un plus #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Simili lavori Capo Controllo Interno, Audit & Stocks (H/F) - CDD 12 mesi Save Paris, France Richemont Senior Policeman H/F Save Paris, France Richemont Switzerland GL
descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR128460 Richemont owns some of the world Each Maison representatives a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seems to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and design new products which are in keeping with our Maisons, through a process of continuous creativity. How are you going to make a difference? As a RFO Trainee, you will have the following responsibilities: Retail accounting: you will come to support various accounting tasks related to the flow of shops (payments, refunds, caisses ...) and will be fully involved in the monthly closing phases. Retail & Stock control: you will integrate the exciting environment of operations to support our team in the operational support of our Swiss market stores (monitoring and support of transactions, inventories ...) Internal control: guaranteeing the correct application of the Group's procedures and guidelines, internal control is a key role for the entity's proper functioning. You will accompany the head of internal control in her daily life (monthly monitoring of checks, annual testing). What are the keys to your success in our Group? You are looking for a training position for an SWC Trade employee branch Administration & Service or equivalent You are comfortable with computer tools You are motivated, rigorous and like to work as a team You have a sensitivity to the world of Retail and operational You speak fluently French and have basics in English, German or Italian is a plus #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Head Internal Control, Audit & Stocks (H/F) - CDD 12 months Save Paris, France Richemont Senior policeman H/F Save Paris, France Richemont GL Accountant Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont
descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR128460 Richemont besitzt einige der Welt Jedes Maison Repräsentanten eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerk und Richemont scheint das Erbe und die Identität jedes seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig setzen wir uns für Innovation und Design neuer Produkte ein, die unseren Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Wie willst du einen Unterschied machen? Als RFO Trainee haben Sie folgende Aufgaben: Einzelhandelsbuchhaltung: Sie werden kommen, um verschiedene Rechnungslegungsaufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Geschäftsfluss zu unterstützen (Zahlungen, Erstattungen, Kasse ...) und werden in den monatlichen Schließphasen voll beteiligt sein. Retail & Stock Control: Sie integrieren das spannende Umfeld des Betriebs, um unser Team bei der operativen Unterstützung unserer Schweizer Marktgeschäfte zu unterstützen (Überwachung und Unterstützung von Transaktionen, Lagerbeständen ...) Interne Kontrolle: Gewährleistung der korrekten Anwendung der Verfahren und Leitlinien der Gruppe ist die interne Kontrolle eine Schlüsselrolle für das ordnungsgemäße Funktionieren des Unternehmens. Sie begleiten den Leiter der internen Kontrolle in ihrem täglichen Leben (monatliche Überwachung der Kontrollen, jährliche Tests). Was sind die Schlüssel zu Ihrem Erfolg in unserer Gruppe?
